import json
codes=[]; invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
text=data.decode('utf-8')
lines=text.split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines.pop()
for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
    if line.strip()=='':
        continue
    try:
        obj=json.loads(line)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if not isinstance(obj,dict):
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if obj.get('level')=='error':
        codes.append(obj.get('code'))
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({'codes':codes,'invalid_lines':invalid},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(open('scratch/errors.json',encoding='utf-8').read())
EOF
